covers: Missing field: the request form never states a retention period
title: Supplier tax compliance verification

F-R1.quote: To confirm, before awarding a supply contract, that the supplier is registered for VAT and in good tax standing.

F-R2.quote: PDPL Article 15(3): disclosure requested by a public entity to implement another law, namely the Government Tenders and Procurement Law.

F-R3.quote: Contracting only with suppliers that meet their tax obligations, as required by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law.

F-R4.quote: Establishment owner name, owner's national ID number, VAT registration number, VAT registration status.

F-R6.quote: Requested by the Ministry of Health from the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority.

F-P1.quote: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority, Data Management Office, privacy@zatca.example

F-P2.quote: Registering taxpayers for VAT and verifying their returns and payments, and enabling contracting government entities to check the VAT registration status of their suppliers.

F-P3.quote: Processing required to implement the VAT Law.

F-P4.quote: Establishment owner name, owner's national ID number, VAT registration number, VAT registration status, tax returns, payments.

F-P5.quote: Individuals and sole-proprietorship owners registered for VAT.

F-P6.quote: Government entities that contract with suppliers, to check their tax status; other government entities where a law requires disclosure.

F-P7.quote: No transfer or disclosure outside the Kingdom.

F-P8.quote: Records are kept for ten years after the end of the tax year they relate to.
